     \]

     \[
     \$10.5/\text{year} - \$3/\text{year} = \$7.5/\text{year}
     \]

5. **Total Net Profit Over Years:**
   - Let \( n \) be the number of years.

     \[
     \text{Total Net Profit} = -\$90 + \$7.5n
     \]

     \[

     \[
     \$7.5n > \$90
     \]
     \[
     n > \frac{\$90}{\$7.5}
     \]
     \[
